label: Iris (circular stop)

blackness.help: fraction of incident power absorbed by the disc (0.95-1.0 typical)

tooltip: Blackened circular aperture stop: an opaque annular disc plus a thin material=air 'plug' filling the opening (the aperture contract, docs/RAYTRACER.md S5.10) so the coherent gather re-anchors correctly at the aperture plane. 'blackness' (0.95-1.0) sets the disc's absorbance property directly -- edit blackness and rebuild to change it (a manual 'absorbance' edit would be overwritten by the next rebuild, since it is re-derived from blackness every time).
